description: Total Variation Distance (TVD) between the user historical normalized channel share and the observed 5-workday normalized channel share.
calculation: Historical weight_c = active_rate_c * mean_active_count_c / P95_c (0 if P95 missing/nonpositive); normalized historical share = weight_c / SUM(weight). Observed share_c = SUM_last_5_WD(daily_count_c/P95_c) / SUM_all_channels_last_5_WD(daily_count_c/P95_c). TVD = 0.5 * SUM_c ABS(observed_share_c - historical_share_c).
time_scope: Rolling 5 eligible user workdays (current and previous 4); full window required
source_columns: external_email_count; usb_copy_count; www_upload_count; email/usb/http P95; email/usb/http active_rate; email/usb/http mean_active
notes: TVD ranges 0..1 and is NaN when a complete window has zero normalized activity. First W−1 eligible workdays per user are NaN, not zero. Workday sequence is user-specific and ordered chronologically; current day is included.

Observed share_c = SUM_last_10_WD(daily_count_c/P95_c) / SUM_all_channels_last_10_WD(daily_count_c/P95_c). TVD = 0.5 * SUM_c ABS(observed_share_c - historical_share_c).
